bridge_functions.name: Wifi.Scan
bridge_functions.description: Return the last cached scan of visible access points immediately and trigger a fresh foreground scan; fresh results are delivered via the NetworksScanned event

bridge_functions.name: Wifi.Current
bridge_functions.description: Read the currently connected access point (SSID/BSSID/RSSI)

bridge_functions.name: Wifi.CheckPermission
bridge_functions.description: Check whether the app currently holds the permission required to read scan results

bridge_functions.name: Wifi.RequestPermission
bridge_functions.description: Request the runtime permission required to scan (NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on API 33+, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION on older devices)
